Fullstop limits how far your Mac charges, right from the menu bar. This is the first release. Pick a limit from 20% to 100%, and Fullstop holds your battery there. Limits of 80% and up use the charge limit built into macOS, so they need nothing else installed. You can leave Optimized Battery Charging on or off.

## Highlights

- A charge limit from 20% to 100%. Charge to Full is there for the days you need the whole battery, and Use Battery runs down to your limit while plugged in.
- Rest between charges. The battery drifts down to a level you choose instead of topping up constantly.
- A heat pause that stops charging when the battery gets hot and resumes once it cools.
- A Modern or Classic menu bar battery with the percentage, a mark for your limit, status symbols, optional status colors, and a yellow fill in Low Power Mode.
- Power flow, Energy Mode, battery health, cycle count, temperature, and a 24-hour chart in the panel.
- Control over the MagSafe light, Shortcuts actions, Siri phrases, and a keyboard shortcut to open Fullstop.

## Install

Download `Fullstop.dmg` below, open it, and drag Fullstop to your Applications folder. Fullstop needs a Mac with Apple silicon and macOS 27 or later. For limits below 80% and the features that pause or redirect charging, install the helper when Fullstop asks and approve it in System Settings.

The app and disk image are signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple. To check your download, compare it with `Fullstop.dmg.sha256`, or verify its build provenance:

```sh
gh attestation verify Fullstop.dmg --repo firatciftci/fullstop
```
